canonical_statement: For a compact-domain Fredholm integral equation of the second kind, under regularity assumptions making the kernel operator compact, either the homogeneous equation has only the zero solution and the inhomogeneous equation has a unique solution for every datum, or the homogeneous equation has a nonzero solution and solvability is governed by orthogonality to solutions of the adjoint homogeneous equation.
domain_and_universes: Candidate only: a compact measure domain, real or complex scalar field, a Banach/Hilbert function space, a regular kernel K, its compact integral operator T, scalar lambda, and datum f.
hypotheses: kernel regularity sufficient to define T
adjoint structure where the compatibility branch is stated
conclusion: The full unique-solvability/nontrivial-kernel Fredholm alternative for (I - lambda T) phi = f, including the adjoint compatibility branch.
